Tags are the right organising model for me, especially because one bookmark can belong to several topics. Lowercasing them, replacing spaces with hyphens, and ignoring a typed `#` all feel sensible. Clicking a tag to place it in the search box is also right because I can refine the search from there.

One piece is missing from tag entry: as I type, the field should suggest matching tags I’ve already used so I can select one instead of accidentally creating a near-duplicate. For example, typing `tra` should offer `travel` if it exists.

I don’t need a separate all-tags overview at this point. Tags on bookmarks, clickable filtering, search, and the existing-tag suggestions are enough.
